dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: You at the front! Keep moving! You at the back — catch up and keep pace!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Double time it! Are you on a run or a date?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Chevreuse! A bunch of stragglers have keeled over!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Really? Fantastic. Guess they've volunteered for extra laps tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: A little combat sprint training, and they're all tuckered out... That's what you get for slacking off during regular drills.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Half push-ups! Chests beneath the bar during pull-ups! Cutting corners on laps! Think you're clever, do you? Thought I wouldn't notice?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: No way they can fight with their muskets like this. What'll they do if a criminal bolts? Ditch their gear and give chase?

choices.text: What does the training involve, exactly?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Nothing, really. It's just getting to the marked location within the time limit while carrying all their gear, retrieving the target item, and running back. That's it.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Their packs don't even include the usual supplies for long-distance deployments. They only have to carry their firearms, ammunition, observation and protective gear, and medkits.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And... how is the location marked?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I launch a signal flare. They must reach the spot where it lands and deploy themselves for battle there.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A flare... Well, those can't fly too far...

response.speaker: Faderne
response.text: *pant* But... Captain... Please stop using... the Gardemeks... to fire the flare...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Another subpar performance, and I'll be firing it from my musket.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Alright! Look alive, you slugs! Time for another round. Don't worry — those who fell out will be joining you. I'll make sure of that!

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: On your feet, now! Move, move, move! Run, walk, crawl, I don't care what you do! I want to see every last one of you at that marker!
